thermocline-cyan.purpose: The instrument. The only colour the interface uses about itself.

lamp-red.purpose: PROVEN and nothing else. An exploit executed and succeeded.

half-light-amber.purpose: DEMONSTRATED (built, never fired) and any run that contacts nothing.

lamp-warm.purpose: The cone's own light — hotter and yellower than Lamp Red, because the cone is light in water rather than a lit mark.

depth-ramp.purpose: One ordered scale, named once. The water column is drawn from it and so is every ground that must sit level with a given depth.

wash.purpose: Secondary text, tinted from the water's own hue. Never grey.

verdict.purpose: The page's h1. Two lines, always, as separate spans so the accessible name keeps the break.

readout.purpose: The two dive-computer numbers. Mono, because they are measurements.

finding.purpose: Three sizes — 30/24/21px — carrying the ranking that no badge is allowed to carry.

data.purpose: Anything the engine measured: proof blocks, field values, coverage sentences.

shadows.name: panel-ambient
shadows.purpose: The only neutral elevation shadow in the system. Panels and only panels.

shadows.name: stage-active
shadows.purpose: The stage the run is currently at. A lit object, per the Lit-Object Rule.

shadows.name: thermocline-bloom
shadows.purpose: The ownership boundary crossing the whole column.

shadows.name: proven-bulb
shadows.purpose: A finding whose exploit executed. The only warm halo.

motion.name: descent
motion.purpose: The lamp's travel down the column. The system's one authored moment.

motion.name: sounding descent
motion.value: velocity, integrated per frame — not an easing curve
motion.purpose: The submersible's travel. It is given a velocity and a frontier, never a duration and never a destination it has not earned: it accelerates under its own inertia and brakes into the frontier on an exponential approach, so it never overshoots and never snaps. Replaced an awaited chain of eased travels with a hold between each, which is what made the descent read as a slideshow.

motion.name: vehicle
motion.purpose: Hull pitch, thruster rotation, ballast bubble rate and the splay of the two floodlights all read one number, so the vehicle cannot be drawn under power while it is holding station.

motion.name: depth colour loss
motion.value: filter: saturate(1 - dsat), quantised to 40 steps
motion.purpose: The sea loses its colour as the vehicle descends; the floodlights sit outside the filter, so by the trench the only warm thing in frame is the light being carried. Quantised because saturate() re-rasterises the plane it is on.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Proof-strength colour changes as a finding ignites.

motion.name: reduced
motion.purpose: Reduced motion resolves to the final state instantly. Read live via a matchMedia change listener, never captured once at load. An infinite animation given a near-zero duration flickers, which is the opposite of what was asked for. In the sounding it removes travel and every ambient loop, but not the sea, which is picture rather than motion — and the run still completes.

motion.name: breach
motion.purpose: A layer's ceiling giving way, once every candidate inside it has been attempted.

breakpoints.name: rail-drops
breakpoints.purpose: Instrument rail moves below the rig as a 2-up; descent narrows to 250px.

breakpoints.name: single-column
breakpoints.purpose: One column, water first, deck unpins, form fields go to 16px.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Tighter gutters, flow chips rotate vertical, thermocline label moves below the marks.

breakpoints.name: short-viewport
breakpoints.purpose: Water body compresses so the depth axis is not truncated.

breakpoints.name: very-short-viewport
breakpoints.purpose: Second compression step. The verdict, thermocline and top of the descent stay on one screen.

namedRules.name: The Lamp Rule
namedRules.text: Warm ink appears only where the engine did the corresponding thing. Red means an exploit executed and succeeded; amber means built-but-not-fired, or a run that contacted nothing. Colour is proof strength, never severity and never emphasis.

namedRules.name: The One Instrument Rule
namedRules.text: Cyan is the only colour the interface may use about itself. Cyan is the product speaking; warm is the run reporting. Never mix registers on one element.

namedRules.name: The Stated-State Rule
namedRules.text: No state is carried by colour or shape alone. Every dashed node, dimmed dot and coloured bulb has the word beside it or a visually-hidden equivalent.

namedRules.name: The Lit-Object Rule
namedRules.text: Depth is carried by light, not drop shadows. A zero-offset coloured halo is permitted only on an element that is emitting. Everything else takes the neutral panel ambient or nothing.

namedRules.name: The Twelve-Pixel Floor
namedRules.text: No text below 12px anywhere. The ramp is 12/13/15/17/21/24/30 plus two clamped display sizes, with nothing in between.

namedRules.name: The Counted-Words Rule
namedRules.text: Every quantity in prose is counted from the findings at render time and spelled from a word table, never authored.

namedRules.name: The Tabular Rule
namedRules.text: tabular-nums on body. Every number sits in a column that has to line up.

namedRules.name: The Stratum Rule
namedRules.text: Each check axis is a layer of the water column with a ceiling of its own, named once in a single table that every picture reads. A candidate is drawn inside its own layer and never outside it; the water darkens by exactly one step of the seven-stop ramp per ceiling crossed. Layer names and the engine's pipeline stage names are separate vocabularies and may not overlap.

namedRules.name: The Unmeasured-Progress Rule
namedRules.text: No percentage, fraction or filling bar for the progress of a run. The engine returns one report at the end and streams nothing, so a progress indicator is segmented by real layers and filled by real attempts — and while the request is in flight it holds where it is and says in words that nothing is proved yet.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action on the surface: Analyze, or Arm & prove. Square, tracked, cyan.

components.name: Field
components.description: A sunk well on a lifted panel. Mono value, cyan caret, 16px on mobile so iOS does not zoom.

components.name: Proof Block
components.description: The executed exploit, printed verbatim on a ground below the page ink. Warm ink only where the attack actually landed; a status the app refused prints in instrument cyan.

components.name: Ownership Chip
components.description: Answers what would happen if you pressed Arm right now. Derived from the form on every keystroke, never from the last report. Three states, three inks.
components.html: Ownership VERIFIED · localhost

components.name: Panel
components.description: A hairline container lifted one value off its ground. Never a card, never nested.
components.html:
PROOF LOG
Waiting for the lamp.

components.name: The Sounding
components.description: The descent, with the screen handed over. Arm & prove locks scroll and makes the page inert; the lamp holds the optical centre while the column travels past it, one stratum per check axis. A layer is breached only when every candidate inside it has been attempted; an empty layer is crossed and says so. It writes no results of its own — it calls the page's ignite() and reads settle()'s verdict back out of the DOM. Esc and one control leave it: before the report that cancels the request, after it that skips to the result.
